name: orbuff-mobile
description: Native mobile release wrapper for Orbuff.

scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap sync
scripts.mobile:add:android: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap add android && npx cap sync android && npm run mobile:assets:android:optional && npm run mobile:configure:android
scripts.mobile:add:ios: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap add ios && npx cap sync ios && npm run mobile:assets:ios:optional && npm run mobile:configure:ios
scripts.mobile:open:android: npm run mobile:sync && npm run mobile:assets:android:optional && npm run mobile:configure:android && npx cap open android
scripts.mobile:open:ios: npm run mobile:sync && npm run mobile:assets:ios:optional && npm run mobile:configure:ios && npx cap open ios
